The next weekly EIA release can test whether the small refill persisted; weather and a pre-release consensus are required to distinguish seasonality from a tradable surprise. If independent balance evidence confirms tightening, upward pressure is possible; warmer weather or supply recovery can reverse it. No price target or probability is estimated. [[SOURCE:SOURCE_1]]

If independent balance evidence confirms tightening, upward pressure is possible; warmer weather or supply recovery can reverse it. No price target or probability is estimated. [[SOURCE:SOURCE_1]]
